# Ascend Benefits Consulting Group
# https://ascendbenefitscg.com

> Ascend Benefits Consulting Group is an independent employee benefits consulting firm specializing in level-funded and self-funded ERISA health plans, reference-based pricing strategies, and preventive care programs for employers with 2–250 employees across Tennessee and all 50 states.

## Services
- Level-Funded Health Plans
- Self-Funded / ERISA Plans
- Reference-Based Pricing (RBP)
- Stop-Loss Insurance
- Preventive Care Management Program (EHP)
- Dental, Vision, Life & Disability
